name: lever standing rear kick
description: A standing machine kickback that squeezes the glutes as you press the leg behind you.
instructions: Stand facing the machine and hold the handles for support.
Place the back of your working leg against the pad.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute.
Pause at the top, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
